questions.question: Which English settlement was founded in Virginia in 1607?
choices: Plymouth
Philadelphia
Jamestown
Savannah

questions.question: Which crop became especially important to colonial Virginia's export economy?
choices: Tobacco
Rice
Wheat
Indigo

questions.question: Which group founded Pennsylvania under William Penn?
choices: Puritans
Anglicans
Catholics
Quakers

questions.question: What was an indentured servant?
choices: A person owning a large plantation
A worker bound to labor for a specified term
An official appointed to collect customs duties
A merchant licensed to trade with Indigenous nations

questions.question: Which elected assembly began meeting in Virginia in 1619?
choices: House of Burgesses
Continental Congress
House of Commons
Provincial Congress of Massachusetts

questions.question: What was the Mayflower Compact?
choices: A royal order creating Pennsylvania
A treaty ending the French and Indian War
An agreement to establish a self-governing community
A law taxing printed materials

questions.question: What was mercantilism?
choices: A policy requiring complete colonial independence
An approach linking national power to controlled trade and accumulated wealth
A system distributing land equally among all residents
An economic policy prohibiting overseas colonies

questions.question: Why did many New England communities develop fishing and shipping industries?
choices: Large rice plantations dominated their interior
Gold mining supplied most of their exports
Their climate favored year-round tropical crops
Coastal access and limited farmland encouraged maritime work

questions.question: How did colonial geography influence Southern plantation economies?
choices: Long growing seasons supported labor-intensive export crops
Short growing seasons favored only subsistence fishing
Mountain terrain made large farms universal
Limited coastal access prevented overseas trade

questions.question: Why did European colonization harm many Indigenous communities?
choices: Trade eliminated every conflict over land
Colonization prevented European diseases from spreading
Disease, land loss, and warfare disrupted their societies
All Indigenous nations adopted the same colonial alliances

questions.question: What was the Middle Passage?
choices: The overland route from Virginia to New England
The forced Atlantic voyage of enslaved Africans to the Americas
The sea route connecting only European ports
The migration of Puritans from England to Massachusetts

questions.question: How did colonial assemblies contribute to political experience?
choices: They gave every resident equal voting rights
They replaced Parliament as Britain's national legislature
They made royal governors entirely powerless
Some colonists practiced representative government at the local level

questions.question: Why did colonial voting rules limit participation?
choices: Property, sex, race, and other restrictions excluded many residents
Voting depended solely on willingness to attend meetings
Only recent immigrants could vote in assemblies
Every colony required identical universal voting rules

questions.question: How did the Great Awakening affect colonial religious life?
choices: It created one official church for every colony
It prohibited religious conversion in British America
It encouraged revival preaching and challenged some established authorities
It ended all disagreements among Protestant groups

questions.question: What did colonial laws increasingly do to African-descended slavery?
choices: Guarantee a short fixed labor term for every enslaved person
Make enslavement hereditary and tie it to racial status
Require enslavers to provide equal political rights
Make slavery identical to voluntary wage employment

questions.question: A historian compares shipbuilding in Massachusetts with rice cultivation in South Carolina. What is most relevant?
choices: A single economy shared identically by all colonies
The absence of Atlantic trade in either colony
The disappearance of agriculture throughout the colonies
Regional differences in environment and labor systems

questions.question: Which order places these settlements chronologically?
choices: Jamestown, Plymouth, Pennsylvania
Plymouth, Pennsylvania, Jamestown
Pennsylvania, Jamestown, Plymouth
Jamestown, Pennsylvania, Plymouth

questions.question: Which comparison of slavery and indentured servitude is accurate?
choices: Both always ended after seven years of work
Neither involved legal restrictions on workers
Indentures generally had fixed terms; racial slavery increasingly passed to descendants
Only indentured servitude supplied plantation labor

questions.question: A colonial merchant objects to rules restricting trade to approved ships and ports. Which policy is involved?
choices: Northwest Ordinance
Navigation Acts
Homestead Act
Kansas-Nebraska Act

questions.question: Which evidence challenges the claim that colonial America was uniformly religiously tolerant?
choices: Pennsylvania included Quaker settlers
Colonists built churches in port towns
Religious groups crossed the Atlantic
